title: Woolify
description: Change the color of wool with a single click.
body:
Woolify
Woolify is a client-side Fabric mod designed for builders, map makers, and creative players. It brings an elegant, Axiom-style quick-switch UI to the vanilla block palette, allowing you to seamlessly change the color of blocks on the fly without cluttering your inventory or opening menus.

Features
🎨 Quick Color Switching: Hold a dyeable block, press the keybind (default V), and a sleek vertical color picker will appear on your HUD.
📜 Scroll to Select: Simply scroll up or down to cycle through all 16 Minecraft colors.
🧱 Supported Blocks: Works out of the box with Wool, Terracotta, Concrete, and Stained Glass.
☁️ Client-Side: The mod is purely client-side! You can use it on any server.
🛠️ Creative Mode Sync: In Creative mode, selecting a new color automatically updates the item in your hotbar and syncs to the server. (In Survival mode, the change is visual/client-side only).
How to Use
Place a Wool, Terracotta, Concrete, or Stained Glass block in your main hand.
Press and hold the Woolify Keybind (Default: V).
Scroll your mouse wheel to cycle through the colors.
Release the keybind to apply the selected color to your hand.
You can change the keybind in the game's Options menu under Controls -> Key Binds -> Woolify.

Requirements
Minecraft 1.21.11
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Why Woolify?
When building large structures or experimenting with palettes, constantly opening the creative inventory to find the right color shade breaks your flow. Woolify keeps you in the zone by putting the entire color spectrum at your fingertips with a single, intuitive gesture.
